name: brew-bliss-film
description: Brew Bliss — 'Morning Smile' 15 s portrait brand film. Every frame rendered in a real browser (Three.js/WebGL + Canvas 2D) at t = frame/60; score and sound effects synthesized in JavaScript at 48 kHz stereo.

scripts.build: npm run audio && npm run video && npm run mux && npm run qa && npm run package
